Convolutional Neural Networks for Sentence Classification
We report on a series of experiments with convolutional neural networks (CNN) trained on top of pre-trained word vec- tors for sentence-level classication tasks. We show that a simple CNN with lit- tle hyperparameter tuning and static vec- tors achieves excellent results on multi- ple benchmarks.
